Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Wednesday 14 May, 7 to 9 pm would be our first choice. if that slot isn't free, Thursday 15 May from 6 to 8 pm could work instead, but please don't offer other dates or times. the room already has a drum kit and amps, and we'll bring our own cymbals, so that's the setup we're planning on.\n\nplease ask them to confirm whether one of those two slots is available and what the rehearsal cost would be. i haven't checked the calendar myself, so don't say either time is open or imply we already have a booking. do not modify records; the request is only to draft a message asking about availability and price. keep it friendly and straightforward, like a normal note to a venue contact, not a formal letter. mention Juniper Room and the band size, and make the Wednesday option clear as the preference, with Thursday as the fallback. don't add anything about deposits, payment method, or other equipment, since i haven't given those details.", "output": "Draft a friendly, straightforward message to the booking contact at Juniper Room for a four-piece band seeking a drum rehearsal next week. Ask whether Wednesday 14 May from 7 to 9 pm is available; if not, ask about Thursday 15 May from 6 to 8 pm as the only alternative. Mention that the room has a drum kit and amps and that the band will bring its own cymbals. Ask for the rehearsal cost. Do not imply that either time is available or already booked. Do not modify records. Do not add details about deposits, payment methods, other equipment, or additional dates or times."}]
